scope: Independent source review of actual gateway durable tool-budget call path. No production/migration edits, database/cloud/native/paid/provider execution.

criteria.assertion: Root-approved exclusive production paths, migration contract and exact candidate freeze; preserve existing model ledger, public0.1/private0.2/catalog/source-disabled semantics and all original assertions.

Actual createToolDispatch reserve/settle/markUncertain path composes the concrete persistence-backed tool-budget implementation in a source-only trusted composition; injected canned acknowledgements alone are insufficient.

Trusted stable invocation/reservation identity permits replay-safe accounting: exact replay cannot double debit or redispatch; altered binding/operation/arguments/usage under an existing identity denies. Argument equality alone is not invocation identity.

Reservation and transitions preserve complete tenant/actor/conversation/run/attempt/worker/writerFence and capability/policy bindings; model/caller DTO fields cannot supply trusted cost or broaden budget/authority.

Fresh current state, revocation, expiry and stale replacement checks occur within the authoritative accounting transition, including after lock waits; dispatch/release authority checks and deadlines remain effective.

Explicit trusted tool cost/usage policy defines finite safe integer microUSD and output/runtime/turn treatment; held plus consumed liabilities enforce caps without reset, underflow, overflow, or model-ledger double counting.

Atomic reserve precedes effect; commit acknowledgement loss, cancellation, timeout, process interruption and unknown outcome retain liability. No automatic retry, refund, expiry release or fresh-id bypass of unresolved prior work.

Settlement is bound to original reservation and trusted measured usage; replay has at most one debit, mismatched/elevated usage denies or quarantines without erasing liability. Uncertain cleanup does not overwrite a terminal settled state.

Independent actual-dispatch tests cover success, duplicate replay/concurrency, stale/revoked/expired state, missing/malformed/parked reserve and settlement, lost acknowledgements and uncertainty cleanup failure; source connectivity remains disabled in production composition.

Inspect real SQL transactions, unique keys/locking/isolation and source integration separately from a local fake/recording executor. Any engine/concurrency/crash/reconnect tests authored but unrun remain explicit; no fake DB durability claim.
Original gateway deadline/authority/negative controls remain unchanged and relevant suites pass or retain diagnosed failures; source tests are evidence only, not closure of actual G1 runtime gates.
Exact commit/tree/source hashes, before/after checks, raw failures and remaining authority/engine gates recorded; bounded local cleanup, no background jobs or external actions.
